blocks.content:
Fundamental Rights are basic human freedoms guaranteed to all citizens (and in some cases non-citizens) to ensure equality, liberty, and dignity.

These rights protect individuals against arbitrary actions of the State.

items: Fundamental Rights act as a shield specifically against arbitrary actions of the State.
Exam questions frequently test the distinction between rights available only to citizens versus those available to all persons (including non-citizens).

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Fundamental Rights represent basic human freedoms necessary for individual development.
They are guaranteed to all citizens and, under specific provisions, extended to non-citizens.
Their primary objective is to uphold equality, liberty, and individual dignity.
They act as a constitutional check against arbitrary actions by the State.
